youtube_title: Cashback Coins Are NOT Money: Read the Fine Print | They're Tricking You #12 #Shorts
youtube_description:
THEY'RE TRICKING YOU #12. Rs 100 cashback, but you got 100 coins. Are coins cash? Comment A or B!
Answer: B. One major shopping app's own T&C says its coins can't be converted to cash, can't be transferred and have no monetary value. They expire 6 months after credit, and the program can be changed or ended without notice. Real cashback is money in your bank account.
Source: a major shopping app's coin terms and conditions (Nov 2026).
Education only, not financial advice.
